evidence: FinFeedAPI's official MCP tutorial exposes stock-market tools described as Level-1 quotes and gives 'Get me NBBO for TSLA' as an example, with REST/WebSocket/MCP programmatic surfaces.
Its official Stock API pricing is Pay-As-You-Go at $1 per credit with data-transfer/usage charges; Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 data are billed under the metered tiers.

The Stock API FAQ explicitly states FinFeedAPI does not offer a traditional free plan. New qualified organizations receive $25 of non-expiring promotional credits, after which usage is billed; payment/billing infrastructure is part of the production model.
Therefore a free API key or signup credit is only a trial/credit grant and cannot satisfy XRAY's permanent-$0 end-user entitlement gate C.

Because C fails independently, XRAY does not infer strict A from glossary/tutorial wording alone; a future reopen would still require exact consolidated SIP/National-NBBO lineage and independent quote/trade event timestamp proof.

gate_analysis.A: UNPROVEN_STRICT_LINEAGE; tutorial/glossary NBBO wording alone is not sufficient
gate_analysis.C: FAIL_METERED_PAYG; STARTUP CREDITS ARE NOT PERMANENT ZERO

reopen_condition: FinFeedAPI must offer permanent-$0 production US-equity NBBO quote+trade access with no metered usage, subscription, trial expiry, payment-method, balance, funding, activity, account-maintenance or per-query monetary condition, while primary sources prove exact consolidated UTP/CTA lineage and independent quote/trade event timestamps.
